ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Htran/NATBypass Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects executable names or flags used by Htran or Htran-like tools (e.g. NATBypass)

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\htran\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\lcx\\\.exe$")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ \\-tran\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ \\-slave\\ .*")))
